description: RAG retrieval eval cases for the layout index. `expected_section_ids` are the ground-truth section_id(s) a good retriever should surface in the top-k. These ids must match real section_ids in your page_layouts (a section_id is the UIComponentRef `id` of a top-level component). The seed ids below mirror the master-templates blueprint structure (standard.ts) — adjust them to whatever your extractor actually produced before trusting the numbers. Set `tenant_id` to scope a case to one tenant (multi-tenant isolation), or omit to search across all.

cases.query: What is the hero banner section on the home page?
cases.rationale: Page-specific: locate the hero on home.
